title: Thoughtseed Ecosystem Graph V1
description: Proposal-only, read-only projection of Thoughtseed/Cambium repos, organs, and data planes with evidence-graded edges. Not a runtime dependency; not an authority for deploy, routing, or identity decisions.

authority.description: This graph is a proposal/sketch, not a registry of record. It never gates deploys, routing, or identity.

source.description: Names of the background-research documents this graph was seeded from.

findings.description: Notable discrepancies or gaps surfaced while assembling the graph. Informational only; does not authorize fixing the underlying registries.

nodes.description: Node `id` values must be unique; enforced by the validator script as a semantic check since JSON Schema has no portable keyword for uniqueness across an object property.

localDir.description: Directory name relative to the ecosystem root, used only by the read-only liveness probe for `git log -1`. Omitted for nodes that are not their own git checkout (workers, data planes, ports).

edgeEvidence.description: code-verified: backed by a concrete artifact cited in the research lanes (registry.json, adapters.json, a Cloudflare resource map, a named source file, a systemd unit file). doc-inferred: inferred from prose/narrative description only, or explicitly marked unverified in the source sketch.

kind.description: Verb describing the edge, e.g. depends, deploys, reads, writes, routes.

source.description: The specific artifact or lane note this edge is graded from.

action.description: Every finding here is informational; this contract never edits registry.json, adapters.json, or portfolio-map.v1.json.
